submission.natural_language_explanation: Fires when the current token continues or completes a conventional multiword pairing or semantic frame set up by the preceding words — typically the first subword of the completing word (p of pita, j of jellies/jockey, V of VH1, nan of nanites, P of Potsdam/Piles) or a frame-evoking modifier (chief, Giant, make, sophisticated) or list/code marker (<, :, comma) — firing more strongly when the preceding context licenses that completion and weakly otherwise.

adversarial_test_results.detail: Tests a novel conventional food pairing completion (chips after fish and) in a fresh context.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: The radio station played rock and roll all weekend long.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Tests a novel conventional music pairing completion (roll after rock and) unlike any example.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: Please pass the salt and pepper from the kitchen shelf.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Tests another conventional table pairing completion (pepper after salt and) with new words.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: The company's chief executive announced major layoffs yesterday.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Tests the frame-evoking modifier chief licensing its conventional completion executive.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: Shopping list for the party: bread, cheese, fruit and wine.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Tests a list-evoking colon plus commas in a novel shopping-list context.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: The homepage source began with <div class="main"> content here.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: Il a commandé un croque monsieur avec des frites chaudes.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Tests a conventional multiword pairing completion in French, checking language generality.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: After the quarrel they wanted to make amends and move on.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Tests the frame-evoking verb make licensing its conventional completion amends.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: The theatre performed Romeo and Juliet to a packed house.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Tests a conventional title pairing completion (Juliet after Romeo and) in a theatre context.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: The kids ate peanut butter and jelly sandwiches for lunch.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Tests a novel peanut-butter pairing completion (jelly) distinct from the jams-and-jellies list examples.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: She circled the letter p printed at the bottom of the poster.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Same trigger token ' p' with no licensing pairing, testing unlicensed weak firing.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: He scribbled the letter j twice in the margin of his notebook.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Same trigger token ' j' with no licensing pairing, testing unlicensed weak firing.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: They packed hummus and diesel fuel for the camping trip.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Keeps the hummus-and context but substitutes an unconventional completion the hypothesis should reject.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: They stored jams beside diesel in the old garage room.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Keeps the jams topic but removes the list frame and uses an unconventional associate.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: The dictionary entry for the word chief lists five separate senses.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Uses chief metalinguistically so it evokes no title frame despite matching the trigger token.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: The spelling exercise asked students to copy the word Giant three times.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Uses Giant metalinguistically so it evokes no frame despite matching the trigger token.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: The mechanic could not identify the make of the damaged car.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: The word making contains six letters in total.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Uses making metalinguistically with no preceding frame licensing a completion.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: In math class we learned that five < ten is a true statement.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Uses the exact ' <' token as a prose comparison operator, not a list or code marker.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: The program printed the string "<hello world>" to the console screen.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Places < inside a string literal where it joins the quote (token '"<'), not a code marker.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: The train is scheduled to depart at 3:30 tomorrow morning.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Uses a colon as a time separator, not a list or code marker.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: The stadium holds 1,000,000 spectators at full capacity.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Uses commas as thousands separators, not list markers, testing delimiter specificity.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: Hello, how are you doing today my old friend
adversarial_test_results.detail: Uses a comma as a greeting comma with no list frame present.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: They debated vegan-friendly foods and music festivals without naming any dish.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Keeps the vegan-foods and music-festival topic but removes every pairing, list and frame.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: The new intern learned to jockey the forklift around the warehouse aisles.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Uses jockey as a verb (to operate machinery), so the exact ' j' token appears with no radio frame.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: They visited Paris during the summer holidays last year.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Uses Paris, which tokenizes as a whole word rather than the ' P' trigger, with no licensing frame.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: She bought a Volvo station wagon in Gothenburg recently.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Uses Volvo, which tokenizes as a whole word rather than the ' V' trigger, with no licensing frame.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: The nanny looked after the twins every afternoon.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Uses nanny, which shares its onset with the nan trigger but tokenizes as n + anny, with no nanites frame.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: // remember that a < b holds in this algorithm always
adversarial_test_results.detail: Keeps the exact ' <' token but places it inside a code comment rather than as a code marker.
